messages:
sam_support: Escalation - GraphIQ pilot can't complete onboarding due to combined seat + SSO errors. Reported 10:22 UTC. Customer demo with execs tomorrow; marking high priority (renewal signal at-risk).

sam_support: Key symptom: invites accept but users not provisioned; SSO log shows transient token validation error when provisioning tries to finalize. Snippet:
```text
[2026-03-24T10:21:03Z] INVITE_OK org=graphiq-pilot-2 user=lead@graphiq.ai
[2026-03-24T10:21:03Z] PROVISION_FAIL org=graphiq-pilot-2 user=lead@graphiq.ai err=TOKEN_VALIDATION_FAILED detail=jwt_missing_kid
```

ps_bot: Incident created: INC-2034-110; severity=high; routing to eng-runtime.

rachel_cs: I'll own comms. Please share affected org ids, POCs, and whether billing shows seats available. We need a short note for the CTO and the trial owner explaining impact + mitigation. Matt (AM) can you confirm renewal status in SFDC?

sam_support: Affected orgs: graphiq-pilot-2 (reporter: lead@graphiq.ai), graphiq-trial-01. Billing: seats_total=50 seats_used=12. No obvious seat exhaustion. Issue started after our nightly auth key rotation at 02:00 UTC. I attached ST-11011 to the incident with rotation trace.

isha_prod: Looks like the auth rotation removed the old JWKS thumbprint before downstream services picked up the new keys. Provisioning's token validator got a JWT without a matching kid. Quick mitigation: re-add old key to JWKS endpoint for 1hr or restart provisioning service to pick up new keyset. Options: (A) temporary re-add old key (low risk, quick) (B) restart provisioning instances (may cause small traffic blips). I can perform A if support approves. Command to add old key via admin console is: 
```bash
redwood-admin keys jwks add --org graphiq-pilot-2 --key-id old-rot-20260324
```
I recommend option A to avoid any customer-visible blips.

matt_am: Please do the re-add now. We'll need a comms line: apologetic, say we applied a temporary keys compatibility fix, invites now provisioning, and we'll schedule a security-safe rotation validation in follow-up. I'll flag renewal as "engaged" in SFDC and join the exec demo.

sam_support: I've opened CR-9934 to authorize re-adding the key for both orgs. Also updated SFDC with incident link and renewal note.

isha_prod: Re-added old key to JWKS for graphiq-pilot-2 and graphiq-trial-01. Re-triggered provisioning for pending invites. Result: PROVISION_OK / user appears in roster. Verified SSO login flows now succeed end-to-end.

rachel_cs: Draft comms (short):
1) Apology + impact: "some new users couldn't finish onboarding due to a token validation issue after our auth key rotation"
2) Mitigation: "we applied a temporary compatibility fix and retried onboarding; invites should now complete"
3) Next steps: "we'll validate rotation process, remove the compatibility key after verification, and propose a 15-min pre-demo validation"
4) Ask: accept 15-min pre-demo check at 08:30 PT?

matt_am: Sent invite to customer and internal attendees for 08:30 PT. Also added a renewal-friendly line offering a one-week trial extension if they want extra time post-demo.

sam_support: Support will keep ST-11011 open and monitor token validation metrics for the next 24h. Also leaving a note: do not rotate JWKS without issuing a staged key update.

isha_prod: I'll follow up with a short postmortem and a PR to add staged key rollover to our runbook. Will post ETA for removal of old key after 24h verification.

rachel_cs: Owners recap: (1) CS send comms + run pre-demo check (rachel_cs) (2) AM handle renewal framing + join demo (matt_am) (3) Eng to harden key rotation + remove compatibility key after verification (isha_prod) (4) Support monitor ticket and metrics (sam_support). :white_check_mark:

ps_bot: Incident INC-2034-110 updated: status -> mitigated; note added by isha_prod.
